question: Pallavi bought a toy for ₹578, decorated it at a cost of ₹14 and sold the toy for ₹476. Find the loss or profit percentage.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total CP = 578 + 14 = ₹592

Ratio of CP : SP = 592 : 476 = 148 : 119

Loss in ratio = 148 − 119 = 29 parts

Loss % = (29 ÷ 148) × 100 = 725/37%

**∴ The correct answer is 725/37% loss.**
